section_summary: This page is a cross-reference note concerning U.S. purchases of Japanese gold. It points to a November 14, 1939 communication from Japan reporting an Asahi article that said a lapse in treaty relations with Japan would not affect those purchases.

people.name: Joseph C. Grew
people.role: Sender of the referenced communication from Japan

subfiles.about: An Asahi article said treaty relations lapsing would not affect U.S. purchases of Japanese gold.
